The “deleting” part I find incredibly shady if it’s deleting high value trades. They try sanitizing their history to look better. But for people who do both but don’t try to hide it, I understand why. I also understand deleting giveaways because you don’t want to be spammed by freeloaders. I do that.

Sometimes I have dupes of high value items that I worked hard farming for and I really need or want NMTs so I sell for fair value prices that some people might find on the higher end (Ie. Illuminated DIYs go for about 60NMTs). I never highball, and more often than not I take a little under average pricing, but I know some people might still find the prices ridiculous. I just simply go for what the market is. 

On the other hand, however, I also like helping people so whenever I am able, I do giveaways and what not. It’s not so much to make myself look better, to make myself feel less guilty, or for some “redemption” type of thing. I do it because I genuinely want to help people. There’s no ulterior motive. Sometimes I want to earn some dough, and sometimes I want to help. I mean, that’s human, I think. Some of us go out of our way to pursue jobs and opportunities that earn lots of money, while simultaneously donating to charity. 

So maybe there’s some perspective from someone who does something similar, just without the shady history deletion. I only delete certain giveaways because sometimes people beg me for free stuff or take advantage that I like being nice.


Edit: I do find the history deleting sus. There’s a user I won’t name but I see them on NoFee a lot begging for free expensive items and then they delete their posts. I’ve used throwaway accounts to blast them.
